_comment: Act affixes: a named, announced modifier on everything an act sends. They exist so that two acts with the same drone list are not the same problem twice - a Swift act wants range and reach, a Hardened act wants damage per shot rather than shots per second, a Relentless act takes the between-wave breathing room away from a plan that needed it.
_why_not_random: Authored per act in the wave file, not rolled at runtime. A modifier a player cannot see coming is not strategy, it is a surprise, and this game is deterministic on purpose: the same act is the same act, so it can be learned, lost to, and beaten.
_how_they_apply: Every field here is a multiplier or a flat bonus on a value the simulation already had, applied once when the act loads. Nothing here changes what happens in a tick - which is exactly why the whole system costs nothing at runtime and cannot desync a replay.

hardened.blurb: Reinforced plate - armour comes off every hit

resilient.blurb: Field-hardened hulls - more health across the board

relentless.blurb: No pause between waves worth the name

screened.blurb: Inertial screens - slowing fields barely bite

massed.blurb: Every group is bigger, and every kill pays less

austere.blurb: Salvage crews stripped the wrecks - bounties are thin
